The '''Tarkin Memorial Conference Center''' was located in [[Eriadu City/Legends|Eriadu City]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the same name. [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], after whom the center was named.

==Layout and design==
The Tarkin Memorial Conference Center was designed in a roughly circular pattern around the main conference room which also served as a banquet hall. A large hallway surrounded the main conference room with access to two smaller conference rooms, a command center, a large kitchen with pantry, restrooms, two lounges, a large reception area, and a security office with armory. There were also two detached elevated dining rooms.

==History==
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] most well-to-do citizens were scheduled to conduct highly secretive negotiations at the [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkin]] Conference Center, an ambitious [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] enforcer tried to impress his [[Vigo/Legends|bosses]] by robbing as many attendees of the meeting as possible. He offered a generous percentage to any thug or crew that could successfully steal from the highest number of attendees.
